text: Acceptance amendment: attached MCP and CLI activity reads return a semantic work card alongside raw evidence: campaign/run, unit label and phase, array index or packed member, command/analysis label, declared resources, dependencies, expected outputs, validation status, snapshot commit/digest, and semantic-context freshness. An unattached or stale read must explicitly say so and fall back to raw identity. Tests prove semantic resolution is identical across MCP, CLI, and library readers for the same attached snapshot.
